name: sellflow-reef

sources.name: sellflow-docs
sources.notes: Company documents held inside the reef: wiki export, OpenAPI spec, tickets, plans, procedures, minutes, handover, postmortem, Slack export, registry, sprints, data exports, spreadsheets. Indexed so artifact citations to them resolve.

description: 셀플로우 — a Korean e-commerce fulfilment company. Five services handle ordering, daily partner settlement, inventory, delivery lookup and settlement anomaly detection. The reef also covers the company's own documents: wiki export, API spec, tickets, plans, procedures, meeting minutes, a handover, an incident postmortem, chat and mail threads, a service registry, sprint records, data exports and two spreadsheets.
output_language: English (quote Korean source text verbatim when citing)

services.name: Order
services.description: Customer ordering and cancellation, the outbox that tells settlement a cancel happened

services.name: Settlement
services.description: Daily partner payout batch, the cancel-reconciliation queue, and anomaly detection over settlement results

services.name: Inventory
services.description: Stock levels and restock-on-cancel, which depends on the cancel reason code

services.name: Delivery
services.description: Carrier status proxy for the app; ownership is unsettled in the registry
